_note: How calendar events count in the Secretary app. A starting template: make it yours. Rules are tried top to bottom on each event's title and location (case-insensitive regular expressions); the first match wins, and anything unmatched counts as the default. The kinds are fixed: work, social, exercise, travel, health, learning, fun, errands, personal. To add your own words (your company's name, your team's meetings, your gym or club), tell the secretary bot, e.g. 'count anything with Acme in it as work', or edit a 'match' here (words separated by |, \b marks a word edge) and run `python3 secretary/sync.py push`. Sleep and workouts come from the health bot's logs when it is installed, not from here.
